---- MODULE ZkV3_7_0 ----
EXTENDS ZkV3_7_0Defs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL ZKProofFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

ZKProofCommitType == \A s \in Server : lastCommitted[s].index \in Nat

ZKProofCommonPrefix ==
  \A i, j \in Server :
    \A k \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap (1..lastCommitted[j].index) :
      TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])

ZKProofUniquePositions ==
  \A i, j \in Server :
    \A k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
      \A l \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
        TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][l]) => k = l

LEMMA ZKProofTxnReflexive == \A t : TxnEqual(t, t)
BY SMTT("r1") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA ZKProofTxnSymmetric ==
  \A t, u : TxnEqual(t, u) => TxnEqual(u, t)
BY SMTT("r1") DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA ZKProofMinimumPair ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
  PROVE /\ Minimum({a, b}) \in {a, b}
        /\ Minimum({a, b}) <= a
        /\ Minimum({a, b}) <= b
        /\ (a <= b => Minimum({a, b}) = a)
        /\ (b <= a => Minimum({a, b}) = b)
<1>1. \E n \in {a, b} : \A m \in {a, b} : n <= m
  BY SMTT("r1")
<1>2. {a, b} # {}
  BY SMTT("r1")
<1>3. /\ Minimum({a, b}) \in {a, b}
       /\ \A m \in {a, b} : Minimum({a, b}) <= m
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SMTT("r2") DEF Minimum
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, SMTT("r1")

LEMMA ZKProofPrefixByIndex ==
  ZKProofCommitType /\ PrefixConsistency => ZKProofCommonPrefix
<1>1. ASSUME ZKProofCommitType, PrefixConsistency,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             NEW k \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap
                       (1..lastCommitted[j].index)
      PROVE TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
  <2>1. lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat /\ lastCommitted[j].index \in Nat
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommitType
  <2>2. LET m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index})
        IN /\ m \in {lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}
           /\ k \in 1..m
           /\ m > 0
    BY <1>1, <2>1, ZKProofMinimumPair, SMTT("r2")
  <2>3. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, SMTT("r2") DEF PrefixConsistency
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommonPrefix

LEMMA ZKProofPrefixAgreement ==
  ZKProofCommitType /\ ZKProofCommonPrefix => Agreement
<1>1. ASSUME ZKProofCommitType, ZKProofCommonPrefix,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             IsFollower(i), lastCommitted[i].index > 0,
             IsFollower(j), lastCommitted[j].index > 0,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW l \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      PROVE \/ \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
                  TxnEqual(history[j][n], history[i][k])
            \/ \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
                  TxnEqual(history[i][n], history[j][l])
  <2>1. lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat /\ lastCommitted[j].index \in Nat
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommitType
  <2>2. CASE lastCommitted[i].index <= lastCommitted[j].index
    <3>1. k \in (1..lastCommitted[j].index) \cap
                 (1..lastCommitted[i].index)
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r1")
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[i][k])
      BY <1>1, <3>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommonPrefix
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, SMTT("r2")
  <2>3. CASE lastCommitted[j].index <= lastCommitted[i].index
    <3>1. l \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap
                 (1..lastCommitted[j].index)
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>3, SMTT("r1")
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][l])
      BY <1>1, <3>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommonPrefix
    <3>3. QED BY <3>1, <3>2, SMTT("r2")
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF Agreement

LEMMA ZKProofPrefixTotalOrder ==
  ZKProofCommitType /\ ZKProofCommonPrefix /\ ZKProofUniquePositions
  => TotalOrder
<1>1. ASSUME ZKProofCommitType, ZKProofCommonPrefix, ZKProofUniquePositions,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             lastCommitted[i].index >= 2, lastCommitted[j].index >= 2,
             NEW k \in 1..(lastCommitted[i].index - 1),
             NEW l \in (k + 1)..lastCommitted[i].index,
             \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
               TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
      PROVE \E n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
              /\ TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
              /\ \E m \in 1..(n - 1) :
                   TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][m])
  <2>1. lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat /\ lastCommitted[j].index \in Nat
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommitType
  <2>2. PICK n \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
          TxnEqual(history[i][l], history[j][n])
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2")
  <2>3. /\ k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
         /\ l \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
         /\ k \in 1..(l - 1)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r1")
  <2>4. n = l
    BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofUniquePositions
  <2>5. k \in (1..lastCommitted[i].index) \cap
               (1..lastCommitted[j].index)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, SMTT("r1")
  <2>6. TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
    BY <1>1, <2>5, SMTT("r2") DEF ZKProofCommonPrefix
  <2>7. QED BY <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>6, SMTT("r2")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF TotalOrder

LEMMA ZKProofInitPrefix == Init => PrefixConsistency
<1>1. ASSUME Init, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server
      PROVE LET smaller == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index,
                                     lastCommitted[j].index})
            IN \/ smaller = 0
               \/ /\ smaller > 0
                  /\ \A index \in 1..smaller :
                       TxnEqual(history[i][index], history[j][index])
  <2>1. /\ lastCommitted[i].index = 1
         /\ lastCommitted[j].index = 1
         /\ history[i] = <<BootstrapTxn>>
         /\ history[j] = <<BootstrapTxn>>
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitServerVarsL
  <2>2. Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}) = 1
    BY <2>1, ZKProofMinimumPair, SMTT("r1")
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2, ZKProofTxnReflexive, SMTT("r1")
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, SMTT("r2") DEF PrefixConsistency
